description: Everything on one Roblox game right now: players now and its place on Roblox, the change over 1 and 24 hours, highs (24 hours, 14 days, since tracking began on Sep 27 2026), momentum and 7-day average, its genre and its place in it, its developer and the people behind it, its latest updates with how players moved after each, its closest rivals, its places on Roblox’s charts, and a 7-day line of its players (spark_7d). Start here for any question about one game.
